listening.enter.mode_epoch: current server epoch; initial normal epoch is 0

sequence.scope: job trace; monotonically increasing; deterministic request_id
sequence.duplicates: same accepted seq and identical payload: return current state, no action; changed payload: reject; old evicted seq: reject, query state with a new seq

authorization: actual LiveKit participant equals expected dev-SN
strict worker service auth plus bound grant for internal HTTP
entry_completion: old capture tasks drained and Worker queue cleared
Android confirms local prompts and playback queues stopped

feedback.singing_trigger: button; or voice_command only with negotiated listening_voice_control_v1 and frozen voice_invitation_enabled=true; voice_invitation remains forbidden for singing
feedback.user_speaking: reject request while input active; new speech revokes reserved/active permit; speech_end never resumes cancelled output

lease.failure: do not extend; pause silently on expiry; old session closes before ordinary new session

ack.entry: received is not ready; completed follows Worker drain plus Android local_ready; the completed entry ACK echoes original enter request_id/command_seq
ack.state_query: new seq; returns current snapshot, never consumes another speech permit
ack.timeout_action: query state with a new seq; do not assume listening or resume local audio; close session if no trustworthy response

buffer.older_than_ledger: conservative summary invalidation and explicit context gap
buffer.summary_reply: bound to authenticated room/session/trace/listening_id plus retained ticket and buffer instance; stale reply rejected
buffer.gap: true for source loss OR unsummarized prefix omitted from recent context; never infer uninterrupted complete recall

voice_control.default: not granted unless all negotiation conditions hold; does not expand gate/allowlist/scenes
negotiation: Android POST /v1/device/session supports includes BOTH listening_mode_v1 and listening_voice_control_v1.

Approved release agent capabilities AND fresh authenticated worker-ready capabilities both include listening_voice_control_v1 in addition to the original five; same approved build and applied config ack remain required.

Existing tuning.voice_invitation_enabled=true at session issue. No new setting/schema; old config/hash unchanged. Brain includes optional voice_control:{version:1,capability:listening_voice_control_v1} in signed job listening metadata AND Android listening_contract only after negotiation; absence means unsupported.

Brain persists only negotiated capability for internal voice_command authorization. New entry consumes frozen tuning; turning voice invitations off applies to new entries, existing entry keeps its snapshot. Safe explicit exit is not blocked by the invitation flag. Gate/lease/registry revocation still closes old RTC, never bypassed.

proposal.android_seq: ABSENT; Worker never allocates Android seq
proposal.actions: enter requires scene; exit omits scene; no feedback proposal needed (existing Worker single permit). No raw command text in control payload.
proposal.trust: Android checks actual publishing Worker participant matches current expected agent/room, current trace/session and target dev-SN. Worker checks actual returning participant equals bound dev-SN, trace, epoch, original action/scene, current authority and live pending proposal. src string alone is never authentication.

android_echo.rule: Only negotiated clients may echo proposal_id. Android allocates its usual next seq/request_id and copies proposal epoch/action/scene exactly; Worker consumes live proposal once. Identical Android retransmission uses same seq/body and returns existing ACK; never consumes another proposal. local_ready stays unchanged. Missing proposal_id is the old manual/button flow, not a voice source.

lifecycle: At most one pending proposal per job; proposal_id trace:voice:counter is Worker-local, never an Android seq. Retransmit only the same proposal; never reset its deadline. Worker uses monotonic 3000ms since creation; Android drops after <=3000ms since receipt and never extends on duplicate. Worker deadline is authoritative against delayed delivery; no clock sync assumption.

Enter recognition immediately suppresses ordinary chat/speculation/filler and cancels pending ordinary output; receipt is not success. Android automatically stops local prompts/queued playout, keeps microphone and idle policy active, sends enter, then local_ready at received epoch. No spoken confirmation in v1.
Completed entry ACK still needs BOTH Worker output drain and Android local_ready; echoes original enter seq/request_id. Never label proposal delivery or received ACK as listening success.

Keep STT/capture alive on wake FIRST utterance and throughout pending/entering. Strip command prefix only; same-utterance tail and subsequent narrative enter bounded pending story buffer, then listening buffer on completed. Never send command/tail to ordinary chat/memory. On overflow/gap report context gap; do not claim complete recall.

Expired/rejected/conflicting proposal, entry timeout or authority loss keeps output silent; query state using new Android seq, then close/rebuild RTC if state untrusted or paused. Do not replay narrative through ordinary chat or auto-retry entry after expiry. Duplicates do not create new proposals or feedback turns.

Explicit valid exit cancels feedback, discards pending output, closes old entry through existing flow; completed ACK state normal means ordinary chat may handle NEXT new speech. No catch-up replay of story/lyrics. Exit failure/lease expiry stays paused and requires new RTC; voice does not recover revoked authority.

feedback.source: Worker explicit called-name end-of-story/end-of-song command, not Android button
feedback.requires: negotiated voice capability + frozen voice_invitation_enabled + current lease and existing one-turn permit/cooldown/VAD/epoch gates
feedback.singing: Only standalone called-name after-song phrase after input end; no generic invitation, punctuation, lyrics question, goodbye or just 讲完了. No button spoof. No acoustic evaluation from STT.
feedback.privacy: Strip control phrase from story/summary/ordinary chat/long-term memory; question may contain sanitized intent description, not raw voice command. One feedback then listening; speech revokes permission as before.

voice_control.legacy: No new capability => no proposal, no singing voice_command; old manual Android controls/button and enabled story/sharing voice_invitation remain unchanged. Never imply full voice mode exists on old APK.

recognition.kind: finite explicit STT phrase rules; no LLM classifier; not zero-false-trigger
feedback_story: 小可我讲完了请说说你的看法
小可我说完了请给我反馈
feedback_singing: 小可我唱完了请给我反馈
exit: 小可结束倾听恢复聊天
recognition.normalization: Whitespace and Chinese/ASCII punctuation only; require called-name at start; enter may have trailing story text, feedback/exit must be standalone. Reject quotation/reporting prefixes and incomplete ASR prefixes; final STT commits only. Singing feedback only after speech_end, no new song classifier.
